mechanism_narrative: A lower level of the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signals an accommodative monetary policy stance that reduces the discount rate applied to equity cash flows, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS < 3.0% in the prior month is followed by negative 20-day S&P 500 returns in more than 60% of cases, or the Rank IC between FEDFUNDS and 20-day returns is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the unemployment rate above 5.0% signals economic weakness that triggers Federal Reserve rate cuts, reducing equity discount rates and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: UNRATE > 5.0% is followed by negative 20-day S&P 500 returns in more than 60% of cases, or the Rank IC between UNRATE and 20-day returns is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) from prior month indicates robust consumer spending and business investment, boosting corporate earnings and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST and RSAFS both increase from prior month
failure_condition: When HOUST and RSAFS both increase from prior month, the S&P 500 produces negative 20-day returns in more than 60% of cases, or the Rank IC between the interaction signal and returns is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: During high industrial production growth regimes (INDPRO > 120), a continued expansion in manufacturing output signals sustained economic strength, supporting positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: INDPRO > 120 is followed by negative 20-day S&P 500 returns in more than 60% of cases, or the Rank IC between INDPRO and 20-day returns is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A lower level of the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) signals disinflation, reducing the risk of aggressive monetary tightening and supporting positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: CPIAUCSL < 190.0 is followed by negative 5-day S&P 500 returns in more than 60% of cases, or the Rank IC between CPIAUCSL and 5-day returns is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A housing starts level above 1850 thousand units signals strong residential construction activity, indicating a robust economy and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: HOUST > 1850 is followed by negative 20-day S&P 500 returns in more than 60% of cases, or the Rank IC between HOUST and 20-day returns is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) and retail sales (RSAFS) from prior month indicates strong labor market conditions driving consumer spending, boosting corporate earnings and supporting positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 days.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS and RSAFS both increase from prior month
failure_condition: When PAYEMS and RSAFS both increase from prior month, the S&P 500 produces negative 20-day returns in more than 60% of cases, or the Rank IC between the interaction signal and returns is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In late-cycle expansion regimes, a federal funds rate above 3.5% signals successful soft landing management by the Federal Reserve, reducing recession risk and supporting positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 days.
failure_condition: Late-cycle expansion regimes with FEDFUNDS > 3.5% are followed by negative 60-day S&P 500 returns in more than 60% of cases, or the Rank IC between FEDFUNDS and 60-day returns in late-cycle regimes is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
